name: Heads Up

text.trigger: A survivor finishes a search at the Police Station.
text.vignette: The evidence room has two containers still sealed: a battered cooler and a steel drum. Whichever one you pry open, something inside is going to scream back at you.

options.cooler: Pop the cooler lid: the noise fills the Police Station.
options.drum: Unscrew the drum: the same racket fills the Police Station.

notes: src: Crossroad_cards_v1.1.xlsx.txt card #59; both options have the same effect on the printed card (fill every noise space; addNoise caps at the location's spaces)
